description: This file contains shell script code for testing various 'git push' operations with different options, including porcelain output, atomic push, force push, and cleanup of refs. It simulates different scenarios and checks the git push behavior and output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to format it in a user-friendly and stable manner.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Stores an expected output pattern for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output against expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Verifies current refs against expected refs in the repository.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters certain lines from output for comparison.
